id.description: A unique identifier of the dataset.

title.description: An optional human readable title for the dataset. Will be derived from id if not provided explicitly.

description.description: An optional description of the dataset.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this dataset.

table_path.description: A table path in the data source delimited by / character.

sql.description: A sql statement that represent a table.

oneOf.title: Primary key
oneOf.description: A primary key for the given dataset.

oneOf.title: Composite primary key
oneOf.description: A primary key for the given dataset.

fields.description: A list of fields in this dataset.

references.description:
A list of references, specifies the relations between datasets.
Foreign dataset is defined in "dataset" attribute and will always be joined by it's grain.
Current dataset will be join by the column name defined in "using" attribute.

workspace_data_filters.description: A list of workspace data filters to be applied to the dataset.

data_source.description: An optional data source id used for the specific dataset.

precedence.description: An optional precedence value for the dataset (whole positive number).

dataset_type.description: An optional dataset type. Standard datasets have direct data mapping. Auxiliary datasets are helper datasets without data mapping. Defaults to standard.

oneOf.title: Auxiliary dataset
oneOf.description: Synthetic reference target for pre-aggregation datasets. Per gdc-nas, AUX datasets must not carry table_path, sql, precedence, or workspace_data_filters; data lives in the referencing pre-aggregation datasets.

id.description: A unique identifier of the date instance.

title.description: An optional human readable title for the date instance. Will be derived from id if not provided explicitly.

description.description: An optional description of the date instance.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this date instance.

title_base.description: A title for the title formatting

title_pattern.description: A pattern for the title formatting

id.description: A unique identifier of the metric.

title.description: An optional human readable title for the metric. Will be derived from id if not provided explicitly.

description.description: An optional description of the metric.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this metric.

show_in_ai_results.description: Optional flag to indicate if the metric should be shown in AI results. When omitted, the metric is visible.

id.description: A unique identifier of the computed attribute. Must not collide with the identifier of an attribute or a label.

title.description: An optional human readable title for the computed attribute. Will be derived from id if not provided explicitly.

description.description: An optional description of the computed attribute.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this computed attribute.

maql.description: Define MAQL syntax for the computed attribute. Values are assigned with break points written as CASE WHEN branches over a metric, and the first matching branch wins.

format.description: An optional Excel-like format string applied to the computed values.

metric_type.description: An optional categorization of the computed values semantics, for example currency.

data_type.description: An optional data type of the computed values. Defaults to STRING on the backend.

value_type.description: An optional specific type of the computed values. Defaults to TEXT on the backend.

is_nullable.description: Optional flag to indicate if the computed attribute can contain null values.

null_value_join_replacement.description: Optional value which can be used as replacement for NULL in join conditions.

show_in_ai_results.description: Optional flag to indicate if the computed attribute should be shown in AI results. When omitted, the computed attribute is visible.

locale.description: An optional locale in BCP 47 format (for example en-US) whose collation order the computed values are sorted by.

id.description: A unique identifier of the dashboard.

version.description: Dashboard model version. "2" (default if omitted) — legacy shape: root-level sections/filters are also mirrored into a default tab, producing a declarative model with duplicated content for backward compatibility with older SDK readers. "3" — clean shape: tabs are the sole source of layout and filters; root sections/filters in YAML are still allowed as an authoring shortcut but are wrapped into a single synthetic tab without duplication. Use "3" for new dashboards; "2" exists to keep existing files round-trippable.

title.description: An optional human readable title for the dashboard. Will be derived from id if not provided explicitly.

description.description: An optional description of the dashboard.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this dashboard.

cross_filtering.description: Whether cross filtering is enabled for this dashboard. Defaults to true.

user_filters_reset.description: Whether user can reset custom updated filters. Defaults to true.

user_filters_save.description: Whether user filter setting will be stored in local storage. Defaults to true.

filter_views.description: Whether user can save and apply filter views for this dashboard. Defaults to true.

persistent_filters_across_tabs.description: Whether persistent filters across tabs are enabled for this dashboard. Defaults to true.

timezone_config.description: Dashboard-level timezone configuration. If omitted, the workspace or organization timezone setting is used.

enable_section_headers.description: Applies to the root layout. Whether all sections headers are enabled. Defaults to true.

sections.description: A list of sections in this dashboard.

plugins.description: A list of plugins in this dashboard.

id.description: An unique identifier of the plugin.

parameters.description: Parameter that will be passed to the plugin. Everything other than string will be serialized to JSON automatically.

oneOf.description: An unique identifier of the plugin.

tabs.description: A list of tabs in this dashboard. Each tab has its own layout, filters, and filter configurations. Mutually exclusive with sections and filters at dashboard level.

title.description: An optional human readable title for the plugin. Will be derived from id if not provided explicitly.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this plugin.

id.description: A unique identifier of the document.

title.description: A human readable title for the document.

description.description: An optional description of the document.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this document.

period.description: The finished period the document covers. It is not a filter: at execution time it materializes as an absolute date filter on each visualization's date dataset, at the lowest precedence, which a visualization opts out of with ignore_report_period.

pages.description: Ordered pages of the document. A page is a deep copy taken when it was added, and never changes with the page layout or template it came from.

filters.description: Document filters; pages and visualizations may extend or override them.

variables.description: Custom variables the document's text can interpolate as {name}. Built-in variable names win a collision.

takeaways_instruction.description: Instructions every AI takeaway without instructions of its own is generated with. Supports {variables}.

variable_values.description: Values for the declared variables, keyed by variable name. A variable with no value here falls back to its default.

id.description: A unique identifier of the document template.

title.description: A human readable title for the document template.

description.description: An optional description of the document template.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this document template.

pages.description: Ordered pages of the template. A document created from the template deep-copies them and keeps no reference back, so the document stays frozen while the template evolves.

filters.description: Template filters; pages and visualizations may extend or override them.

variables.description: Custom variables the template's text can interpolate as {name}. A document created from it gives them values.

takeaways_instruction.description: Instructions every AI takeaway without instructions of its own is generated with. Supports {variables}.

report_page_layout.title: ReportPageLayout

id.description: A unique identifier of the document page layout.

title.description: A human readable title for the document page layout.

description.description: An optional description of the document page layout.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this document page layout.

style.description: Paint of the page itself, behind everything the layout places.

layout.description: Root of the page layout tree.

filters.description: Page filters, carried into the template and document content this page is copied into.

report_page_layout.description: A reusable page. Its content fields are the same page body a document and a document template carry inline, so a field added to /gaac/reportPageBody belongs here too: JSON Schema cannot compose the two, because the page body closes itself to the entity's own id, title and tags.

id.description: A unique identifier of the document. Ids starting with default. are reserved.

not.$comment: Only a document template sets content.defaults.period. Each level states type: object, because a value that is not an object satisfies required and properties, so the rule would also fire on it.

publisherDocumentTemplateV2.title: Publisher Document Template V2
publisherDocumentTemplateV2.description: A document created from the template gets a deep copy of its content and keeps no reference back.

id.description: A unique identifier of the document template. Ids starting with default. are reserved.
A unique identifier of the page template. Ids starting with default. are reserved.

content.description: Copied into a document, with a page id added, when the template is used.

attributeIdentifier.title: Attribute Identifier
attributeIdentifier.description: A attribute identifier in the form of attribute/{id}.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Locale string in BCP 47 format (for example en-US or cs-CZ-u-kn-true).

labelIdentifier.title: Label Identifier
labelIdentifier.description: A label identifier in the form of label/{id}.

computedAttributeIdentifier.title: Computed Attribute Identifier
computedAttributeIdentifier.description: A computed attribute identifier in the form of computed_attribute/{id}.

publisherEntityTagsV2.title: Publisher Entity Tags V2
publisherEntityTagsV2.description: A list of strings - metadata tags.

publisherPeriodV2.title: Publisher Period V2
publisherPeriodV2.description: The period the document reports on, in the date filter grammar without a dataset. Numbers for from and to make it relative; dates make it absolute. Both ends are inclusive.

from.description: Offset from the current period, for example -1.

to.description: Offset from the current period, for example -1.

publisherDocumentContentV2.title: Publisher Document Content V2
publisherDocumentContentV2.description: Holds exactly one of pages and sections.

filters.description: Document filters. Date filters name their date dataset. At most one filter per attribute or date dataset.

locale.description: Overrides the workspace locale for this document.

format_locale.description: Overrides the workspace format locale used for dates.

not.$comment: Rejects both and neither. type: object, because a value that is not an object satisfies required, so the rule would also fire on it.

publisherPageSizeV2.title: Publisher Page Size V2
publisherPageSizeV2.description: The widescreen design canvas is 1920 x 1080 px.

publisherLayoutNodeV2.title: Publisher Layout Node V2
publisherLayoutNodeV2.description: A row or column container, or a widget.

publisherDocumentPageV2.title: Publisher Document Page V2

id.description: Unique within the document.

visible.description: Defaults to true. A hidden page is left out of the viewer, exports and page numbers.

kind.description: Editor hint. It does not change how the page renders.

notes.description: Markdown speaker notes, never drawn on the page.

layout.description: Root of the page layout tree.

filters.description: Page filters, applied on top of the document filters.

publisherDocumentPageV2.$comment: The keys are a page body's plus id and visible. JSON Schema cannot extend the closed /gaac/publisherPageBodyV2, so a key added there belongs here too.

instructions.description: Instructions the takeaway is generated with.

widgets.description: Ids of the widgets on this page the takeaway is generated from.

publisherColorValueV2.title: Publisher Color Value V2
publisherColorValueV2.description: A theme color reference such as {theme.palette.primary}, or #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, or rgb() with 3 or 4 arguments.

publisherImageSourceV2.title: Publisher Image Source V2
publisherImageSourceV2.description: A theme image reference such as {theme.logo}, or an https URL, which may contain text variables.

publisherPxV2.title: Publisher Px V2
publisherPxV2.description: Pixels on the page's design canvas (1920 x 1080 for widescreen).

publisherGapValueV2.title: Publisher Gap Value V2
publisherGapValueV2.description: Space between children, in pixels or as a theme spacing reference.

page_size.description: Applies to every page without its own page_size.

generation.description: Combined with each takeaway widget's own generation.

period.description: Document templates only: the period a document created from the template starts with.

publisherDocumentStyleV2.title: Publisher Document Style V2
publisherDocumentStyleV2.description: Style of the area behind the pages. Exports ignore it.

gap.description: Space between pages in the viewer and the editor.

id.description: Unique within the document.

publisherPaddingValueV2.title: Publisher Padding Value V2
publisherPaddingValueV2.description: Inner spacing, in pixels or as a theme spacing reference.

publisherTextStyleNameV2.title: Publisher Text Style Name V2
publisherTextStyleNameV2.description: Named text style from the theme.

publisherRadiusValueV2.title: Publisher Radius Value V2
publisherRadiusValueV2.description: Corner radius, in pixels or as a theme corner reference.

publisherPageProportionV2.title: Publisher Page Proportion V2
publisherPageProportionV2.description: Share of the parent container this node takes, relative to its siblings. Defaults to 1.

hint.description: Authoring hint shown in the empty widget.

kind.description: Editor hint. It does not change how the page renders.

notes.description: Markdown speaker notes, never drawn on the page.

layout.description: Root of the page layout tree.

filters.description: Page filters, applied on top of the document filters.

metricIdentifier.title: Metric Identifier
metricIdentifier.description: A metric identifier in the form of metric/{id}.

factIdentifier.title: Fact Identifier
factIdentifier.description: A fact identifier in the form of fact/{id}.

start.description: Start of the period the document covers, ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

end.description: End of the period the document covers, ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

id.description: An id for this page, unique within the document.

style.description: Paint of the page itself, behind everything the layout places.

filters.description: Page filters, merged over the document's own. A filter targeting the same object replaces the inherited one; a visualization's own filters apply on top.

name.description: Name the variable is referenced by from text, as {name}.

default.description: Value used when the document gives the variable none.

reportBackground.title: Report Background
reportBackground.description: A bare string is a color. An image is written as a mapping.

oneOf.description: CSS color value painted behind the content.

reportBackgroundImage.title: Report Background Image
reportBackgroundImage.description: The image a box paints behind its content. It is drawn from a slot of its own, which is what keeps a backdrop fillable and gives it placeholder metadata, so it is written down with an id - or it names an image another box on the page already wrote down.

ref.description: An id of an image already written down elsewhere on this page, drawn here as well.

url.description: Image URL, supporting {variables} - a logo uses {logo}. Mutually exclusive with asset.

asset.description: Backend-managed asset rendered as the image. Mutually exclusive with url.

fit.description: How the image fills its area: kept whole inside it, filling it and cropped to do so, or stretched to its shape. Defaults to contain.

reportTextType.title: Report Text Type
reportTextType.description: Size the text is rendered at. Headings default to h1, paragraphs to normalText. The size owns the typography that goes with it; the rest of the style overrides ink and placement on top of it.

reportImageStyle.title: Report Image Style
reportImageStyle.description: Placement overrides for the drawn image; centered on both axes by default.

reportPlaceholder.title: Report Slot Placeholder
reportPlaceholder.description: Metadata of a slot intentionally left unfilled. A bare true marks it required; a bare string is the authoring hint.

oneOf.description: True marks the slot required: the document is not complete until it is filled.
Authoring hint shown in the empty slot.

hint.description: Authoring hint shown in the empty slot.

required.description: When true, a document is not considered complete until this slot is filled.

reportWeight.title: Report Layout Weight
reportWeight.description: Fractional weight of this node inside its parent. Defaults to 1; sibling weights [2, 1] render a 2/3 + 1/3 split.

reportLayoutNode.title: Report Layout Node
reportLayoutNode.description: A node of the page layout. A node carrying column or row splits its area along that direction; every other node draws content, told apart by the content key it carries.

background.description: What the box paints behind its content.

border_radius.description: Corner radius in percent of the page width. Content reaching into a rounded corner is clipped.

padding.description: Inset of the box's own content, in percent of the page width. Insets only inward.

reportSlotId.description: An id for this area, unique within the page. It is what a document fills when it takes this page from a template, so an id written down here survives edits to the layout around it.

reportText.title: Report Text
reportText.description: A bare string is the text itself. AI-written text is a mapping carrying the prompt and the generation it produced.

oneOf.description: Markdown with {variable} placeholders, resolved at render time.

text.description: Markdown with {variable} placeholders. Alongside a prompt this is the materialized generation, stored so the document renders without re-invoking AI.

prompt.description: Instruction for the generator. Its presence makes this an AI-written text; supports {variables}.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the stored generation. Only meaningful alongside a prompt.

reportTextStyle.title: Report Text Style
reportTextStyle.description: A bare string is the text type. Anything more is written as a mapping.

color.description: CSS color value of the text.

reportImage.title: Report Image
reportImage.description: A bare string is the image URL. Anything more is written as a mapping. The id belongs to whatever draws the image, not to the image itself.

oneOf.description: Image URL, supporting {variables} - a logo uses {logo}.

url.description: Image URL, supporting {variables} - a logo uses {logo}. Mutually exclusive with asset.

asset.description: Backend-managed asset rendered as the image. Mutually exclusive with url.

fit.description: How the image fills its area: kept whole inside it, filling it and cropped to do so, or stretched to its shape. Defaults to contain.

reportPageKind.title: Report Page Kind
reportPageKind.description: Editor hint only, for template galleries, default styling and AI context. Geometry always comes from the layout.

reportPageFormat.title: Report Page Format
reportPageFormat.description: Page proportions the layout was authored for. Defaults to widescreen.

fields.description: A list of fields in this query.

filter_by.description: A list of filters in this query.

sort_by.description: A list of sorting in this query.

widths.description: A list of widths in this visualisation.

colors.description: A map of colors in this visualisation.

color.description: A map of color definition in this visualisation.

line_shape.description: Line shape with regards to data points (i.e. line interpolation).

text_wrapping.description: Text wrapping settings for table cells and headers.

wrap_text.description: Enable text wrapping for cell content.

wrap_header_text.description: Enable text wrapping for header content.

page_size.description: Number of rows per page when pagination is enabled.

grand_totals_position.description: Position of grand totals in the table.

custom_tooltip.description: Custom tooltip section rendered in the visualization tooltip, authored in Markdown with metric/attribute references that resolve per hovered data point.

enabled.description: Whether the custom tooltip section is rendered.

content.description: Markdown content. Supports headings, bold/italic, ordered/unordered lists, images, links, horizontal rules, and metric/attribute references ({metric/id}, {label/id}) that resolve per hovered data point.

placement.description: Placement of the custom section relative to the default tooltip content. Defaults to "above".

line_style_mapping.description: Per-series line style and weight overrides. Keys are metric local identifiers, or attribute element URIs (on Tiger, the element's primary label value) when the chart is segmented or stacked by an attribute.

conditional_formatting.description: Conditional formatting rules that color cells or rows based on their values.

version.description: Conditional-formatting model version. "1" (default if omitted) — initial shape: discrete rules, one column per rule with stacked conditions. Readers must tolerate omission (treat as "1") and evolve under the same backward-compat contract as the dashboard model version, so server-side consumers (e.g. XLSX export) stay forward-compatible.

enabled.description: Master toggle for all conditional formatting rules.

rules.description: Ordered list of rules; the first matching rule wins.

id.description: Stable, table-unique rule id.

target.description: The measure or attribute the rule targets — exactly one of measure/attribute.

measure.description: Local identifier of the targeted measure.

attribute.description: Local identifier of the targeted attribute.

conditions.description: Stacked conditions; the first matching condition wins.

value.description: Literal (number or string); a {from,to} range for between/not_between; an {absolute} period or {relative} period for date-attribute conditions; omitted for all/is_empty/is_not_empty.

absolute.description: Static period, snapped to the target date attribute's granularity: from = period start, to = inclusive period end. Platform date strings: "YYYY-MM-DD", or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm" for hour/minute, or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" for hour/minute/second granularities.

relative.description: Relative period re-resolved on every render/export: integer period offsets where 0 = the current period, negative = past. Granularity must be coarser than or equal to (and aligned with) the target date attribute's granularity.

suppressed_targets.description: Targets whose semantic-layer formatting is explicitly suppressed — an entry here with no matching rule means formatting is turned off for that target (Custom-with-zero-rules).

items.description: The measure or attribute — exactly one of measure/attribute.

measure.description: Local identifier of the targeted measure.

attribute.description: Local identifier of the targeted attribute.

description.description: An optional description of the attribute hierarchy.

tags.description: A list of strings - metadata tags of this attribute hierarchy.

columns.description: An optional width of the widget within the grid. When the parent container's direction is set to 'row', widget widths can vary up to the width of the container. When the direction is set to 'column', the width does not need to be set, or it should match the width of the container.

When the parent container's direction is 'row', the height should be greater than the total height of all rows formed by wrapped widgets in the container where row height is determined by highest widget in the row.
